title: RADE manifest
description: The contract between an application and the RADE engine (the Administrator, 2026-11-14). One manifest lists round bundles; the engine builds each bundle into one PowerShell text that is pasted into Windows PowerShell ISE. The engine runs only what the bundle embeds and never fetches code. The engine is engine/rade_build.py in this repo (moved from rhope-ops/90-161.Z on 2026-11-14); this schema matches what it reads. First app: rhope-ops/90-161.Z scripts/paste_bundles.json.

_doc.description: Free text for maintainers. The engine does not read it.

relPath.description: A path relative to the application repo root, or a folder name; never absolute.

out.description: Generated bundle file (.ps1). Never hand-edit it.

round.description: Round id; also the results folder Rounds\<round> and the e-mail subject.

label.description: Ignored from engine-v46 (name spot L3: no round text beside the word; the Administrator, 2026-11-26). Kept so a manifest written for engine-v45 still builds.

title.description: One line on what the round does. Shown in the bundle header; the catalog summary when there is no apps list.

app.description: Application name when there is no apps list. Default: the engine's application name.

files.description: Every file the round writes. Every step's dir and file must be one of these.

fetch.description: Data files the round downloads (never code). Usually empty.

collect.description: Files copied into the results folder after the steps.

cleanup.description: Finished files the round moves to the Recycle Bin (only files the application made).

apps.description: The catalog on the Choose screen. Without it: one application with every step.

release.description: A git tag of the app repo (for example v1.0.0). Fetch files with src then download from that tag, a fixed address, and are still checked by SHA-256; without it they come from main. Tag the commit that holds the bundle and its files.

dir.description: Task folder under the application folder (for example T17).

src.description: Source in the repo. .ps1 .json .txt .md .csv embed as ASCII text; other files embed as base64.
Repo file, downloaded from the bundle's release tag (or raw main without one) and checked by SHA-256.

name.description: File name for a public page (with url).

url.description: Public page, saved as it is (with name).

name.description: Unique in the bundle; apps and collect refer to it.

title.description: Optional. What the RADE window shows a person where it shows the step name (the hand step's headline, the step line of a run, the step boxes in Details). 1 to 56 characters, the same limit as the name; longer is a build WARNING, not a failure. The log, the report, the summary, the results files and every key keep the name. Without a title the window shows the name.

file.description: File name from files[] in the same dir. Empty only for a guide step that needs no file (R18).

kind.description: script: runs as a child powershell.exe. guide: work the user does in another program; RADE opens the address and waits for Done or Skip.

default.description: Ticked or not. An object {passed, paths}: ticked only when those files changed since the round that passed it.

needs.description: Check ids from the engine's check list. The engine owns that list, so this checker does not test the ids; the build fails on an unknown id.

estimate.description: Expected minutes, used for the overall bar until a real run time exists.

minutes.description: Time limit for a script step.

args.description: Extra arguments for a script step.

note.description: Plain-English line shown under the step.

ask.description: A value the window asks for and passes as -<param>.

guide.description: Numbered steps for a guide step, one action each.

urlConfig.description: Config file that can hold the user's own address for this step. The step needs its own url too: a saved address is used only on the host and port of that url (the build stops without it).

url_source.description: Administrator note on where the address comes from. The engine does not read it.

marker.description: File a guide step writes on Done.

makes.description: What the step creates when it PASSES (for example a flow a guide step imports), for the undo list. A script step can also print "MADE <kind>: <name>" lines (docs/engine.md "Step contract"). No site address, no person.

after.description: Names of earlier steps of the same app that must PASS before this step runs; else RADE skips it. In a deploy, an automatic step may come after a hand (guide) step only when it needs it (docs/engine.md "Deploy v1" item 3).

help.description: Plain words on what the user can do when this step needs review (shown under its result). No address, no person.

key.description: Unique in the step; the report line is "  Answer <key>: <value>". No line break (a regex $ also matches before a last line break).

prompt.description: The question: the sentence of its card.

kind.description: yesno: buttons Yes and No. pick: one button per choice. text: one line of at most 10,000 characters (a longer paste is cut and the window says how many characters did not fit), kept whole in the report (empty is recorded as "(no text)"; e-mail and site addresses are masked).

choices.description: The words of the buttons of a pick, each different; only a pick has them.

failOn.description: Only in a step with "answersOnly", for a yesno or pick question: the answers (button words) that mean the step failed. After such an answer the window asks "What did the error say?"; the step is FAILED (reported by you). The other questions are still asked.

key.description: The key of an earlier yesno or pick question of this step.

in.description: The answers (button words) of that question that show this one.

showIf.description: The question shows only when the earlier question got one of these answers; else it is not asked, and its report line says "not asked".

answers.description: Guide steps only: questions RADE asks after the person selects Done (with "answersOnly": at once), one card each, in order. Each answer is one line in the report and the summary, under the step's line. A key must be unique in the step (scripts/check_manifest.py checks it). Text mode records "not asked (text mode)". docs/engine.md "Step contract".

hide.description: Guide steps only: the buttons the step's card does not show (Done, It failed, Skip). One button stays. A hidden button's answer cannot be given, in the window or in text mode. docs/engine.md "Step contract".

answersOnly.description: Guide steps only, with "answers": the window shows the step's first question at once, with no card that has Done, It failed and Skip. The step is PASSED when every question that shows is answered, or FAILED (reported by you) when an answer in a question's "failOn" is given. Such a step has no file, guide lines, address, marker, doneText, doneLog or hide. Text mode cannot ask: the step is SKIPPED there. docs/engine.md "Step contract".

doing.description: Optional. What the step does, in the present tense ("Making the lists."): the RADE window shows it under the step's bar while the step runs, until the step's first item line. 1 to 80 characters; longer is a build WARNING. docs/engine.md "Step contract".

mode.description: deploy: install an app; the run sends nothing (no e-mail draft) and updates the app's record file in RADE\Config\installed (docs/engine.md "Shared files"). test: a test round (the default; Administrator only). drift: the Administrator-only drift check (docs/drift-check.md).

list.description: Title of the app's own list that holds the row.

field.description: Internal name of the text column that gets the version and the date.

marker.description: The install record on the site (docs/engine.md "Guardrails"): after a deploy that reached a step RADE writes the version and the date to this one row (marked partial until every needed step has passed). The sign-in check reads it; a site that has it blocks a deploy from an account that did not install it. Needs mode deploy and a step that needs site-rights.

version.description: The app version this bundle installs (for example 1.0.0). Required for mode deploy; written to the installed-version record.

start.description: Optional. A local .ps1, .html/.htm, or .exe in the app's local install folder (OneDrive\RADE\<application folder>), or an https:// URL. After the checks pass, the Ready screen of an installed app shows a Start button that opens it, then RADE closes.

backup.description: Optional (the Administrator, 2026-11-20). The titles of the app's own SharePoint lists that the Maintenance tool "Back up" saves (JSON plus a CSV copy, on this computer). RADE never finds lists itself; an app that names none gets "names no lists to back up". From engine-v31 a title may hold parentheses.

uninstall.description: Optional (engine-v40; 90-161.Z R43 E3, the Administrator, 2026-11-25). The app's own Uninstall steps, by step name, in run order: steps of this bundle that are not in this app's "steps" (a script that does not read RADE_MODE would install again). Kind script or guide, with no "after" or "ask". The Maintenance card's Uninstall runs them after a typed app name and a fresh Back up, on a test site only (the "restore" test sites), with RADE_MODE=uninstall and RADE_MADE (a JSON file with the made list of the install record). Needs mode deploy and "restore". Without it the Uninstall button is not available.

testSites.description: The site names (the part after the site prefix) where Restore may write, or "local" (engine-v32): the person marks the saved site as a test site on that computer, by typing its name; the mark stays on that computer (for an app whose public repo must not hold a site name). RADE refuses Restore on any other site (the Administrator, 2026-11-20 and 2026-11-21).

pause.description: Optional. The app's pause-switch row: Restore sets its field to the on value before it writes and puts the earlier value back after; the app's flows skip while it is on (plan R2, the Administrator, 2026-11-21). A row the flows do not read yet needs no other setting.

restore.description: Optional (engine-v31). Restore of the lists in backup: missing rows only, Recycle Bin first, on a test site only. Needs backup.

application.description: Facts about the application the engine writes into every bundle.

name.description: Full name on the Choose screen when a bundle has no apps list.

folder.description: The app folder under OneDrive\RADE; also the short name in user text.

prefix.description: File name prefix of the app's own files (Config files, report, e-mail subject).

repo.description: owner/name on GitHub; go.md and fetch files come from its main branch.

home.description: The app's bookmark page, named in the repository check.

displayName.description: Optional (engine-v42; 90-161.Z R44 E2, the Administrator, 2026-11-25). The name a person sees for the installed app, for example "90-161.Z - Kanon". From engine-v46 the shortcut and the Maintenance card use application.productName (else the app name); displayName stays in the shortcut tooltip and the Done line (It opens RADE for <displayName>). Without it, the app name is used. The app name (apps "name") stays the install key, the folder name and the Uninstall confirm text. Letters, digits, spaces, ".", "_" and "-" only, so it is a valid file name.

productName.description: Optional (engine-v45, name spot L2; the Administrator, 2026-11-26). The product's own name, for example "Kanon". It is the word of the application row in the window's logo block, and under the line comes "<name> • <subtitle>". Without it, the word is the app name and the subtitle stands alone under the line. Letters, digits, spaces, ".", "_" and "-", at most 40 characters.

subtitle.description: Optional (engine-v43, L1; the Administrator, 2026-11-26). The line under the application name in the window's logo block, for example "Publications and Forms Management" (with productName "Kanon", the line shows "90-161.Z • Publications and Forms Management"). Without it, the application row shows its word only (with productName: the app name under the line). At most 80 characters; no quotes, no $ and no control characters (the build writes it into the bundle as ASCII text).

logo.description: Optional. Path in the application repo of the application's logo (a PNG; 128 px square is enough). The window shows it at 64 px under the RADE logo, with the application name beside it, once the user chooses the application (the Administrator, 2026-11-18).

logoDark.description: Optional (engine-v48, plan D6; the Administrator, 2026-11-27). Path in the application repo of the application's logo for the dark mode (a PNG, the same rules as logo). When Windows apps use the dark mode, the window shows it in the place of logo; without it, the window shows logo.

own.description: Wildcard patterns of file names the app made; clean-up recycles only these and the known files.

knownDirs.description: [folder, glob] pairs in the app repo: support files with fixed names that clean-up may also recycle.

capabilities.description: Optional capability declarations (e.g. sharepoint, round, aumidPrefix).
